name: 32653 · Gainesville, FL
findings: ZIP 32653 (Gainesville) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32653 (Gainesville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32653 (Gainesville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).
